email contains the trimmed query as a case-insensitive substring, ordered by id, and
`(400, {"error": "invalid query"})` when `q` is missing, not a string, or blank.
Keep the change small and focused.

import pytest
from app.api.handlers import handle_search_users

def test_search_users_invalid():
    assert handle_search_users({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})
    assert handle_search_users({"q": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})
    assert handle_search_users({"q": "  "}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})
    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid query"})

def test_search_users_success():
    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "ad"})
    assert status == 200
    assert data == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}
    
    status, data = handle_search_users({"q": "A"})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data["users"]) == 2
    assert data["users"][0]["id"] == 1
    assert data["users"][1]["id"] == 2
EOF
pytest tests/test_search.py
"}
